notes.title: The Soda Sea Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! After a lot of time and effort I have finally finished the major content update for Super Raft Boat VR: The Soda Sea Update!
[previewyoutube=JZ-PR6Ptz5Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Added 2 new levels:

[b]Arctic Ocean:[/b] for fans of the original Super Raft Boat with icebergs, trouts, and narwhals.
[b]The Soda Sea:[/b] orange soda ocean with pufferfish and soda filled enemies.

Each of these only appear post loop at 50% chance until you complete them. Then they have a 50% chance of replacing a level on the pre-loop.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Wp5nSgb.png[/img]

1 New Elite Type:

[b]Fizzy enemies:[/b] random size, speed, and health modifiers. Explode into bubbles on death.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8gm0HmF.png[/img]

New Enemies:
[list]
[*] Trout
[*] Narwhal
[*] Icebergs
[*] Pufferfish
[*]Added a secret boss, the Catfish
[/list]
New Unlockable Trinkets:
[list]
[*] Raft kit: Getting hit causes rafts to spawn around you in a 3X3 grid. Recharges every level. (Lose 50 rafts)
[*] Third Eye: Enemies outside your vision are slowed and randomly take damage. (Defeat the Catfish)
[*] Orange Soda: Small chance to heal fully at the end of every level. (Kill 50 fizzy enemies)
[*] Sheet Metal: Turn your center raft into a metal raft. This raft can not be destroyed. (Kill 25 metal enemies)
[*] Sniper Scope: Small chance every shot to do 200X damage (Kill 30 gold enemies)
[/list]
Unlockable Trinkets and alternate levels are always unlocked in daily runs for seeding purposes.

New Features:
Best run stat tracked.
Unlocked icons for trinkets in death screen
Melee attack for hands

Bug Fixes:
Really Red Skies achievement fixed

notes.title: Update V1.0.8
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Sorry for the silence, I've been out of town for the last week without a computer to work with. I've pushed a build to fix daily challenges being broken and a few other small issues people had found with the game. 

Now you can get the daily achievement by completing the tutorial and then clicking daily from the menu. Thank you for your patience!
